profile_text.body:
Asana is a publicly traded work and project management software company (NYSE: ASAN, CIK 0001477720) that describes itself as providing a platform for teams and AI agents to plan, automate, and execute workflows together. Its site positions the product around a concept it calls the Work Graph, a shared memory layer that carries completed tasks, feedback, and preferences forward so that context is not repeated and each workflow starts with accumulated knowledge.

The company's AI product, Asana AI, sits within the notes, knowledge, and meetings category and covers work management, goal tracking, team productivity analytics, and data residency options. The site describes a suite it calls Agentic Work Management, which brings together pre-built AI agents it terms AI Teammates, a builder called AI Studio, a dashboard called Asana Dash, and integration tools under MCP and AI Connectors. Teams can also create custom AI Teammates built around their own collective expertise to handle coordination-heavy work.

No litigation or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts for Asana.
